title: Damage Shrinkage Allowance, FBN Warehouse-Damage Approvals
content:
**Which allowance applies on a warehouse-damage approval?** In Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN), the damage shrinkage allowance is waived (0 units) for an enrollment in FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program whose seller stands at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level; for an enrollment in FBN Core Program, FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program whose seller stands at Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level it is the damage per-incident allowance of 1 unit times the number of damaged-in-warehouse inventory adjustments of the case's SKU dated inside the damage review span of 6 months. Every other enrollment's damage shrinkage allowance is left unaltered by this rule.

The seller's level is read from the Seller Performance Standing record. An adjustment is inside the 6-month damage review span when fewer than 6 whole months have passed from its date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month. Only damaged-in-warehouse adjustments are counted, never lost-in-warehouse ones.

## Input, judgement, result

- **Program FBN Premier or Enterprise, level Top Rated or Preferred Partner:** allowance 0 units.
- **Program FBN Core, Growth or Scale, level Above Standard, Top Rated or Preferred Partner:** allowance of 1 unit for each damaged-in-warehouse adjustment of the SKU in the last 6 whole months.
- **Any other pairing** — for instance FBN Starter Program at any level, FBN Premier Program at Above Standard Level, or any program at Standard Level, Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level: not altered by this rule.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An FBN Growth Program seller at Above Standard Level whose SKU has damaged-in-warehouse adjustments dated 1, 4 and 9 whole months ago has an allowance of 2 units: the adjustment 9 whole months old is outside the 6-month span.
